reviewer.name: Codex independent Jiuwudaishi 032 White Horse Post candidate reviewer

summary: Accepted for host curation after an independent sealed replay, direct source-ownership review, exact scope comparison, compact-validation, and chronology-geometry review. Each of the six former Tang chief ministers is explicitly said to have been killed at White Horse Post, and their unmodified death claims date that event to AD 905. The candidate correctly replaces the contradictory strict before-AD-905 attestation bounds with inclusive on-or-before AD 905 bounds and synchronizes exactly the six paired active-date hints, without altering any death claim, source evidence, person identity, mention, or translation.

sourceEvidence.quote: 庚寅，故左僕射裴樞，右僕射裴贄、崔遠並贈司徒；
故靜海軍節度使獨孤損贈司空；
故吏部尚書陸扆贈右僕射；
故工部尚書王溥贈右僕射。
裴樞等六人皆前朝宰輔，為梁祖所害於白馬驛，至是追贈焉。

reviewedChanges.reason: s0057–s0060 identify the six recipients as deceased (故); s0061 identifies Pei Shu and the other six as former-dynasty chief ministers killed by the Liang founder at White Horse Post. The pinned canonical extraction has one AD 905 death claim for each of p043–p048, all citing s0061. A strict before AD 905 bound excludes that documented death year, whereas on-or-before AD 905 is a source-faithful compatible one-sided bound. The candidate changes only those six attestation bound keys and their matching display hints.
